import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):

    sP=np.sqrt(P)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*t**2 + p[2]*P + p[3]*P*t**2 + p[4]*P*t**3
            + p[5]*sP + p[6]*sP*t**2 + p[7]*P**2 + p[8]/P + p[9]*t**2/P)
